sentences.scenario: Describe the weather during a call.
sentences.source_note: Corrects 天气是晴天 with a direct weather description.

sentences.chinese: 我不知道你能不能看到。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ bù zhīdào nǐ néng bu néng kàndào.
sentences.english_hint: I don't know if you can see it.
sentences.scenario: Check visibility while showing something on camera.
sentences.source_note: Corrects 我不知道你可以看; visibility caused repeated difficulty.

sentences.pinyin: Zhège cí yòng Zhōngwén zěnme shuō?
sentences.english_hint: How do you say this word in Chinese?
sentences.scenario: Ask for a word during Chinese class.
sentences.source_note: Complete language-help question for repeated word-finding difficulties.

sentences.chinese: 我觉得你会喜欢这个视频。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ juéde nǐ huì xǐhuan zhège shìpín.
sentences.english_hint: I think you'll like this video.
sentences.source_note: Repeated recommendations omitted 会 when predicting the listener's reaction.

sentences.chinese: 我希望你明天就好起来。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ xīwàng nǐ míngtiān jiù hǎo qǐlái.
sentences.english_hint: I hope you feel better tomorrow.
sentences.scenario: Send a short wish to someone feeling unwell.
sentences.source_note: Corrects 我想明天你很好 by using 希望 for a wish.

sentences.english_hint: I often cooked as a child.
sentences.source_note: Corrects 我小的时候做饭很多 and recurring difficulty expressing childhood.

sentences.pinyin: Wǒ zuówǎn shuì de bù hǎo.
sentences.english_hint: I didn't sleep well last night.
sentences.scenario: Explain why you feel tired today.
sentences.source_note: Analysis corrects 我不睡觉很好 to describe sleep quality.

sentences.chinese: 第二天我们走了很多路。
sentences.pinyin: Dì èr tiān wǒmen zǒu le hěn duō lù.
sentences.english_hint: We walked a lot on the second day.
sentences.scenario: Describe the second day of your trip with your grandmother.
sentences.source_note: Corrects 第二天我们走很多 in the New York travel story.

sentences.scenario: Clarify what happened after your grandmother fell.
sentences.source_note: Corrects 她不……骨折了; the travel story explicitly says she had no fracture.

sentences.scenario: Describe a fall in a lesson picture.
sentences.source_note: Successful reading retained to reinforce 被 and the result 绊倒.

sentences.chinese: 我帮你把东西拿上去吧。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ bāng nǐ bǎ dōngxi ná shàngqu ba.
sentences.english_hint: Let me carry your things upstairs.
sentences.source_note: Useful lesson sentence; the learner struggled to describe the offer of help.

sentences.english_hint: Today is a little better than yesterday.
sentences.scenario: Give a brief update on how you feel.
sentences.source_note: Successful comparison from the reading, reinforced by later comparison difficulties.

sentences.pinyin: Wǒ yuè lái yuè míngbai le.
sentences.scenario: Describe your growing understanding in Chinese class.
sentences.source_note: Corrects 越来越好明白 to the natural structure 越来越明白了.

sentences.pinyin: Yào zuòwán liànxí, cái néng xiūxi.
sentences.english_hint: You can rest only after finishing the exercises.
sentences.scenario: Explain when a study break is allowed.
sentences.source_note: Analysis supplies this study example for 才能, which the learner explicitly did not understand.
